T.V özel Space Apps Challange takımıdır. 

Proje detayları özel olarak görüşülmektedir.
summary: This is a real time multiplayer experience that is theorized on NASA data, making it accessible for children in particular platforms and have fun at the same time.
details: Project works by a complex script that every factor stated in the resource must align in order to succeed the space mission. Players assemble in the control room to collaborate and execute the mission together. The benefits of the program is that it allows players to experience the same level of freedom and opportunity as NASA missions do, which lets them to explore how a mission works and what it can accomplish. We TVF Team used Roblox Engine to build this simulation, built all assets ourselves. Our project is unique and one of its kind on the whole platform.
